purpose: Stress test meaning preservation and edit-strength response on paragraph rewrites. This is original synthetic content; its author-written expectations are not validated human gold.

cases.input: I updated the file at 8:15 a.m., but I have not sent it to Maya because the figures still need checking. I will send it only after I compare them with the original report.
expectations: figures require checking against the original report

cases.input: If the final upload finishes before 6 p.m., I can review the charts tonight. The upload is still in progress, so that plan may change.
The $49 plan dropped to $39 on September 2, 2026, but the annual plan stayed at $120. The notice does not say whether either price includes tax.
expectations: preserve all prices and date exactly
preserve decrease and unchanged annual plan

cases.input: We tested the change on 12 accounts, not all customers. The results suggest fewer errors, but they do not prove why the errors fell.
The first export failed because the folder was read-only. After I changed the permission, the second export completed; I did not change the source file.

expectations: Friday timing is conditional on legal notes

cases.input: The new instructions are shorter, but step 4 still assumes the reader has already opened the settings panel. I have not checked that assumption with new users.
expectations: do not claim the assumption is true

cases.input: I thought the button was missing; it was hidden under the menu. This fix may help first-time users, but we have not tested it on mobile.

expectations: two stopped before the last step
do not change counts or imply all finished

cases.input: After the storm, the north entrance was closed for repairs, while the south entrance remained open. Staff expected repairs to end in late October but did not give an exact day.
expectations: repair end expected in late October

cases.input: The label reads “Keep the original file,” and the link points to version-3.pdf. Change the explanation, not the quoted label or filename.

cases.input: I found two different totals in the spreadsheet. The summary shows $2,460, while the itemized rows add up to $2,406, so I have not sent the invoice.

cases.input: The team could move the launch to Tuesday if testing passes. If the memory issue returns, they may delay it again rather than ship with the bug.
expectations: launch Tuesday is possible, not certain
delay is possible rather than ship with bug
